headline: **MLB Daily Recap: May 23, 2026**
article:
The Houston Astros secured a 4-2 victory over the Chicago Cubs, with Christian Vázquez leading the offense and Spencer Arrighetti pitching a strong 5.0 innings. The Cleveland Guardians shut out the Philadelphia Phillies 1-0, with Kyle Manzardo leading the Guardians' offense with a home run. The Tampa Bay Rays took down the New York Yankees 4-2, with Austin Wells leading the offense with a home run and 1 RBI.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Mickey Moniak, who has been placed on the 10-day injured list by the Colorado Rockies due to right ankle tendonitis. Jung Hoo Lee of the San Francisco Giants has been placed on the 10-day injured list retroactive to May 19, 2026, with a mid-back strain. Other notable injuries include Burch Smith of the Detroit Tigers, Ke'Bryan Hayes of the Cincinnati Reds, Yoán Moncada of the Los Angeles Angels, Yusei Kikuchi of the Los Angeles Angels, Matt Shaw of the Chicago Cubs, and Nathan Church of the St. Louis Cardinals.

The Miami Marlins have acquired outfielder Rece Hinds in a trade with the Cincinnati Reds, sending right-handed pitcher Zach McCambley to the Reds in exchange. The Tampa Bay Rays traded left-hander Joe Rock to the Chicago White Sox for third baseman Oliver Dunn. The Toronto Blue Jays traded left-hander Eric Lauer to the Los Angeles Dodgers for cash, and the Athletics traded center fielder Junior Perez to the Chicago White Sox for left-hander Jackson Nove.
